query: PDS ODE live2, pt=SDNDTM, same box

product.Description:
Shackleton Crater Rim Potential Landing Site for ESA Lunar Lander
        high-resolution NAC digital terrain model in GeoTIFF format. DEM is IEEE
        floating point GeoTIFF, 32 bits/sample, 1 samples/pixel in single image
        plane configuration. Height [m] equals DN. Vertical reference: Height
        above the sphere/ellipsoid (as defined by map axis). The NoDATA value is
        -3.40282266e+038 with a missing constant of -1e+32. For more info, see
        [OBERSTETAL2010].
